def transform(grid):
    split = grid[0].index(5)
    left = [row[:split] for row in grid]
    right = [row[split + 1:] for row in grid]
    if any(left[r][c] and right[r][c] for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(left[r]))):
        return left
    return [[left[r][c] or right[r][c] for c in range(len(left[r]))] for r in range(len(grid))]
